This is a list of grammar rules you need to study for the Japanese Language Proficiency Test level N3.






Click here
to download JLPT N3 Grammar List (printable PDF file).


Click on each grammar point for more details.


あまり (amari)
: so much… that


あまりに (amari ni)
: so much… that, too…


ば～ほど (ba ~ hodo)
: the more… the more


ばいい (ba ii)
: should, can, it’d be good if


ばかりでなく (bakari denaku)
: not only… but also, as well as


ばよかった (ba yokatta)
: should have, it would have been better if


べき (beki)
: must do, should do


べきではない (beki dewa nai)
: must not do, should not do


べつに～ない (betsu ni ~ nai)
: not really, not particularly


中 (chuu/juu)
: during, throughout


だけ (dake) – 2:
as much as


だらけ (darake)
: covered all over in, full of


どころか (dokoro ka)
: far from, anything but
